subject.title: openclaw doctor should detect stale gateway lock files

question: Should maintainers adopt/rebase the open fork PR, or close that stale branch and allow a fresh narrow OpenClaw PR for gateway-lock doctor coverage?
rationale: The bug is valid and narrow, but GitHub still has an open conflicting fork PR with closing syntax, so automation should pause until maintainers choose the ownership path.

options.title: Replace the stale fork branch
options.body: Close or retire the conflicting fork PR and allow a fresh narrow OpenClaw PR that follows current doctor-health patterns and reuses gateway owner-status logic.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the fork work
options.body: A maintainer can manually port the useful fork changes onto current main, keep contributor credit, and close the stale fork PR after replacement exists.

options.title: Wait for the fork author
options.body: Leave the issue paired with the open fork PR and ask the contributor to rebase and add current proof before any new fix lane starts.

recommendation.title: Replace the stale fork branch
recommendation.body: Close or retire the conflicting fork PR and allow a fresh narrow OpenClaw PR that follows current doctor-health patterns and reuses gateway owner-status logic.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history on doctor health-check contracts and the session-lock sibling surface where this implementation likely belongs.
